Hannah — quick thoughts from deal desk POV.

- 35% is outside standard self-serve promo range for published listings but could be approved on a private offer for strategic pilots.
- Recommend we counter at 25% for the first 3 months with a performance review, OR 28% for the full 6-month pilot if customer signs a 6-month commitment and agrees to a co-sell action plan (joint wins & quarterly biz review).
- Require 50% upfront payment for 6-month pilots at >20% discount (mitigates revenue recognition risk).
- Must get marketplace team (Laura) to confirm there are no minimum publish thresholds that block the private offer — some regions enforce minimum MSRP visibility even for private offers.

I'll flag the HubSpot deal and annotate the margin impact. See link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2981.

If the team is okay with 28% for 6 months + 50% upfront + co-sell, I can route for approval today.
